title: config/published-fact-changes.yml
description: The reviewed list of published facts a deploy may change or remove (I-pub, ADR 0011 decision 4). The content tripwire holds any deploy that changes or drops a vote, roll call or outcome already on the live site unless it is listed here. Changed only by a person's reviewed pull request; allow_shrink never counts. An empty list means no published fact may change. Each fact_id appears at most once, and listed_on must be a real day (collector/reviewed_lists.py applies both).

fact_id.description: The id of the published roll call (facts roll_calls[].id; its votes and outcome are what may change) or motion, exactly as in the live data.

change.description: changed: its votes, tally or outcome may differ from the live site. removed: it may disappear.

listed_on.description: The day the entry was added (YYYY-MM-DD).

reason.description: Why the published fact may change, in plain words (e.g. the county corrected its minutes, a rollback).

source_url.description: Optional: the https page that shows the corrected fact.
